question: The formal British rule in India is understood to have commenced in 1757, after the Battle of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Battle of Plassey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Battle of Plassey**

 
 
• Major-General Robert Clive was the first British Governor of the Bengal Presidency.
 
• He began as a writer for the East India Company (EIC) who established the military and political supremacy of the EIC by securing a decisive victory at the Battle of Plassey in Bengal.
 
• The Battle of Plassey was fought in north-eastern India on 23 June 1757.
